p.CALIBRATION: This is a capability prior for the launcher's big-model request, currently `glm-5.3[1m]`. Historic GLM-5.2 runs informed it; every real run records the resolved model and may falsify the prior. Alias text alone proves nothing.

wins.title: Task shapes it tends to win

facts.EXPLICIT-MODULE: A substantial module or repair with explicit architecture, bounded files and executable acceptance.
facts.BROAD-EXTRACTION: Broad local reading that ends in a structured inventory, migration map or concrete code change.
facts.MECHANICAL-BULK: Templated bulk work whose errors are cheap to detect with compiler/tests/diff.
facts.CORRECTION: Same-cwd correction after the parent names an exact failed claim and oracle.

facts.SELF-REVIEW-RISK: A polished report and green worker suite can coexist with public-boundary, identity, containment or false-positive-test defects. Parent review remains mandatory.
facts.BROAD-GATE-RISK: Without an exact command budget the worker may rerun broad slow filters, select zero tests or mask an exit in a pipeline. Packets name commands and expected counts.
facts.REPORT-LATE-RISK: Long reasoning, turn caps and shared quota walls can end before a final report. Write the skeleton early and update it incrementally.
facts.CANONICAL-IDENTITY-RISK: Digest goldens alone do not prove semantic identity. Pair them with typed construction, equality, absent-versus-empty and legacy order/allocation checks when applicable.

p.NO-UNIVERSAL-TURN-CAP: There is no universal 30–50 turn cap. A narrow repair may fit; broad cold archaeology may need a separate report-bearing pass or an uncapped run. Budget from task shape and preserve work at every boundary.

p.PLAIN-OUTPUT: Use ordinary output plus the durable report for long parent-managed runs. Structured event streams are for short probes or file-side telemetry, not bulk context ingestion.
